title: Monument Valley Air and Ground Tour from Phoenix (MVJ)
includes: Transportation to and from the airport (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 3 people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Monument Valley tour includes Sedona, Meteor Crater, and Monument Valley. It begins with a scenic, narrated, flight through the Red Rock formations of Sedona. It then takes in the San Francisco Peaks and the Painted Desert.

The tour continues and may make a brief stop in Page, Arizona, located along the shores of Lake Powell (depending on aircraft).

The flight will continue on to Monument Valley where you will experience the monuments from the air. The flight will land at Gouldings Field, just minutes from Monument Valley, and embark on a guided, 90 minute 4X4 ground tour into the Navajo Tribal Park. Your Navajo guide will provide insights into the culture and beauty of this sacred area. Finally, return to Gouldings Lodge for a delicious Navajo Taco lunch before returning to the airport for the scenic return flight.
